title: Yarn publish token committed in the configuration
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a registry token written directly into the checked-in Yarn configuration. Repository readers can publish as the token owner, and nothing expires the credential when a laptop or CI cache leaks.
remediation: Reference an environment variable and keep the literal out of the file.
limitation: It matches a registry token written directly into the checked-in Yarn configuration in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
